title: OCaml Temporal native client reset request
description: Closed JSON document used only by the private Rust client bridge. The event boundary is a signed Temporal workflow-task finish event ID and must be greater than 1. Runtime validators also reject duplicate keys, NUL bytes, and strings over the 65,536-byte safety limit; maxLength is the character-count bound expressible in standard JSON Schema.

run_id.description: Exact run ID, or the empty string to select the workflow's current run, which Temporal resolves when it handles the request (#791).
